newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Sept 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Sept 27.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Israel's halt of peace process fosters war climate in the Occupied Territories
-- Number of jobseekers in France rose 5.3 percent from the same period last year, with a 1.3 percent increase in August.

-- CGIP plans to buy the 28 percent stake owned by Italian businessman Carlo De Benedetti's Cerus in carmaker Valeo, after selling part of stake in U.S. packaging firm Crown Cork & Seal for an estimated three billion francs.
-- Court puts private airline Air Liberte under legal administration for six-months.
-- Textile group DMC to shed some 1,500 jobs in Germany and France up to June 1997.
-- SNECMA expects to return to breakeven in 1996.
-- British Telecom to invest 8.87 billion francs in Cie Generale des Eaux telecoms subsidiary Cegetel.
